meta.title: Design Proposal — Cornerstone Christian Academy — Bryan, Texas
prop: Design proposal for Cornerstone Christian Academy — not the official school website. Portal uses demo data.
hero.sub: A Christ-centered K–12 academy in Bryan, Texas — where every child is known by name.
statement.text: Since 2002, Cornerstone has believed that educating a child takes a Biblical foundation and a true partnership with the family — so that every student will increase in wisdom and stature, and in favor with God and man.
chapel.p: Songs, prayer and a word from Scripture, every morning. On Fridays, every class recites its memory verse together.
nums.top10s: Nationally on the Stanford Achievement Test
div.p: Core academics every morning. Bible, Spanish, art, music, computers and PE every afternoon. Teachers who know your child.
div.lowerP: Reading, wonder and Scripture memory. Full-day or part-day core options, with extended care from 7:30 AM to 5:30 PM.
div.middleP: Great books, applied mathematics and lab science — plus Spanish, American Sign Language, band and athletics. NJHS.
div.upperP: College-preparatory rigor, the National Honor Society and dual credit through Blinn College.
div.faithP: Daily Bible classes, chapel, the Joanne Walker Day of Service and work days at Messiah’s Ranch.
ath.p: The Lady Cougars claimed a second straight Texas Christian Athletic League Class 2A title — 60 to 30 over Marshall Christian.
her.h: It started with forty believers and one question.
her.lead: In July 2001, Christians across Bryan–College Station gathered to imagine a school that would surround children with the love of God — and equip them to become whatever God intends.
her.openP: August 18 — eleven kindergarten and pre-K students.
her.readingP: By 2005, our kindergartners ranked among the nation’s best in total reading.
her.accP: The smallest school ever accredited by the Southern Association.
her.sciP: The first and only Science Academy in Brazos County.
her.gradsP: A grade added every year — until our first senior class walked.
her.champsP: The Lady Cougars win back-to-back TCAL Class 2A titles.
sent.p: Cornerstone graduates go on to Texas A&M, Harding University, Blinn College and beyond — prepared to go boldly into the world with purpose and love.
adm.lead: Admission is open year-round as space allows. Every family is welcome to a free three-day trial, so your child can experience Cornerstone before you decide.
adm.s1p: Call or email our office to start the conversation.
adm.s2p: Free days in the classroom — for your child and for you.
adm.s3p: Application, enrollment documents and immunization records.
adm.s4p: With the principal or a member of the Board.
adm.s5p: Registration secures your child’s seat. Welcome, Cougar.
pt.lead: Announcements, grades, private messages with teachers, and official school documents — requested in seconds and issued digitally.
pt.f1s: Every notice from school and class, in one feed.
pt.f2s: Direct, private conversations with every teacher.
pt.f4s: Enrollment letters, transcripts and more — download when ready.
